I work as a quality engineer in the aerospace industry. I hold an M.S. in Aerospace Engineering from Florida Tech, focused on flight mechanics and controls, and B.S. degrees in Aerospace Engineering and Computer Science. In my projects I derive a vehicle's model, identify it from data, design the controller, and test it in simulation.

Selected projects

MEE 5690 · MTH 5320 · MTH 5335Solo

Cart-pole control research

One plant across three courses: model it, identify it from data, then stabilize it with MPC, learned controllers and reinforcement learning.

AEE 5803Solo

Lunar lander adaptive control

A lunar lander controller with RISE feedback for translation and an adaptive attitude loop, built and tested in a 3D simulation.

AEE 5805Solo

Spaceflight mechanics and sequential rendezvous

Orbital mechanics in Python, from Kepler's equation and orbital elements to a sequential rendezvous with two targets.

Independent studySolo

Multirotor MPC path planning

Reimplementing a published planner: cluster a point cloud, build a Voronoi roadmap and flight corridors, then fly through a tunnel with MPC.

MTH 5320Solo

CNN occupancy-grid navigation

Teaching a network to draw a collision-free path on an occupancy grid, and comparing a U-Net with a fully connected baseline against A*.
